name: Computer Age Management Services Ltd
title: Computer Age Management Services Ltd - 543232 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: CAMS Q4 FY26 quality beat: EBITDA margin back to ~46.5% and non-MF revenue +24.5% YoY, but MF revenue flat (+0.5% QoQ) with yield drift, KRA pricing cut ~20% and FY27 KRA guided flat.

triggers.label: Non-MF revenue +24.5% YoY
triggers.quote: This time, it's 24.5% year -on-year. And for the year, we are close to 18 percentage.

triggers.label: KRA industry price down 20% from April
triggers.quote: uniformly, the KRA industry has taken a 20% price down.

triggers.label: MF revenue flat, +0.5% QoQ
triggers.quote: mutual fund revenue was sort of flat, almost 0.5% growth.

triggers.label: Headcount flat ex-rearch; FY27 falling headcount
triggers.quote: in FY '27, we will see all the revenue growth on falling headcount

guidance.quote: we are very sure of maintaining this 20% plus growth of non-mutual fund revenue
our aim is to at least re tain what we are in Q4
we will look at a sub-5% and overall, definitely sub 9% kind of a growth in expenses
we will have flat KRA revenue
we will get to a 20% margin by the end of next year
Now our aim and our calculations are that this will not be 3%. This will be less than 3%.

prior_guidance_check.quote: my cost increase has bee n 9 percentage

evasions.quote: nothing so far concrete and nothing for me to report as something that will definitely be there

red_flags.label: KRA price cut ~20% from April 2026 pressures revenue
red_flags.quote: uniformly, the KRA industry has taken a 20% price down.

red_flags.label: Possible AMC yield renegotiation (3-5 bps)
red_flags.quote: we don't rule out the possibility of something like that happening over the next month or 2
